assets.label: 蒸汽军工厂
assets.assetType: compact early-industrial steam arsenal evolved from the blacksmith workshop
assets.primaryRequest: Follow the supplied revision-3 steam-arsenal model. Preserve one compact brown-gray brick workshop, one uninterrupted gray-blue metal gable roof, exactly one brick chimney, one broad side window, the attached left-wall flywheel with its small base cylinder and the small gear-and-hammer emblem above the right furnace. The left front loading doorway stays genuinely open: both full door leaves are rotated inward 90 degrees against the jambs, revealing the recessed dark interior and floor. Keep the right furnace with a small restrained orange internal glow, the tall attached mechanical forging hammer at the far right, and the low small processing machine beside stacked material boxes and exposed metal blanks. Preserve the hammer and wrench on those boxes. This box-and-machine group has replaced the former outdoor table: do not rebuild a tabletop, table legs or a tabletop vise. Retain all exact component positions, one complete shallow fieldstone footing, matte black iron and quiet low-saturation worn materials. Use diffuse fill and only narrow contact occlusion so the entrance and equipment remain readable.
assets.negativeRequest: No closed loading door, blocked entrance, outdoor table, workbench, tabletop vise, hoist, second factory hall, second chimney, roof skylight, tower, extra steam engine, boiler yard, exposed pipe network, CNC cabinet, induction furnace, power-station equipment, finished cannon, weapon rack, vehicle, people, animal, sign text, neon or broad furnace glow. Absolutely no cast shadow of any kind, ground shadow, backdrop shadow, green-screen shadow gradient or detached ambient shadow.
assets.detailRequest: Refine only material surfaces and fine finish. Keep the selected composition, all modeled openings and component layout unchanged.
